style: Asset for Turnip Works, a cosy rustic fantasy tabletop game with heroic hand-painted miniatures. Style: a BIG, BOLD, CARTOONY painted sticker, like a hand-painted game token: chunky simple silhouette, thick dark-brown ink outline all the way round, flat saturated painted colour with one soft highlight and one soft shade, a little brush texture, no fine detail, no hairlines. It must read instantly when it is only 30 pixels tall, floating over a miniature's head. Exactly ONE subject, centred, filling about 80% of the square frame, generous clear margin, nothing cut off. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background (alpha 0 outside the subject), no floor, no cast shadow, no frame, no circle or badge behind it, no text, no letters, no logo.

orbiters.orb-charmed: One plump PINK cartoon heart (hot pink, a lighter pink highlight), slightly tilted, like a love-struck cartoon heart.
orbiters.orb-stunned: One fat five-pointed YELLOW cartoon star (golden yellow, rounded points), the kind that circles a dazed cartoon character's head.
orbiters.orb-frightened-ghost: One little PURPLE cartoon ghost (lavender-purple sheet ghost with a wavy bottom), wide scared eyes and an open 'O' mouth, cute not scary.
orbiters.orb-frightened-bang: Two bold RED exclamation marks side by side, '!!', chunky and slightly wobbly like a cartoon alarm, red with a dark outline. (These two marks are the only glyphs allowed.)
orbiters.orb-blinded-eye: One cartoon EYE (white eyeball, dark pupil) with a thick black diagonal slash crossing it out, like a 'cannot see' sign but painted and cartoony, no circle around it.
orbiters.orb-blinded-cloud: One small BLACK cartoon storm cloud (charcoal-black puffy cloud, dark-grey highlights) with two little dark raindrops under it.
orbiters.orb-grappled: One cartoon GRABBING HAND, ORANGE-TAN (a tan-orange glove-like hand), fingers curled as if clutching, seen from the side, chunky fingers.
orbiters.orb-restrained: One heavy cartoon PADLOCK in BRASS-GOLD with a short loop of dark iron CHAIN through its shackle (three or four chunky links), the padlock large and the chain short.
orbiters.orb-poisoned-skull: One cartoon SKULL AND CROSSBONES, painted bright TOXIC GREEN (lime green skull and bones, darker green shading), cute-spooky.
orbiters.orb-poisoned-bubbles: A tight cluster of three or four round bright TOXIC GREEN bubbles of different sizes, bubbling upward like poison, glossy highlights.
orbiters.orb-paralyzed: One jagged electric-BLUE cartoon lightning spark (a zig-zag bolt with a little starburst at its middle), bright cyan-blue with white highlights.
orbiters.orb-zzz: One big cartoon letter 'Z' for sleeping, puffy and rounded, pale sky-blue with a white highlight and a dark outline, slightly tilted. (This single Z is the only glyph allowed.)
orbiters.orb-exhaust-skull: One plain cartoon SKULL, bone-white with grey shading and black eye sockets, no crossbones, simple and bold.

decals.base-runes: Asset for Turnip Works, a rustic fantasy tabletop game. A flat MAGIC RUNE CIRCLE seen exactly from straight above (top-down, orthographic), to be laid on the floor around a miniature's base: a ring band of hand-painted glowing arcane runes between two thin concentric circles, warm GOLD with a soft amber glow, the centre completely EMPTY (a clear round hole, the miniature stands there, about 60% of the diameter). Perfectly round, centred, filling about 92% of the square frame. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background and transparent centre. No text in any real alphabet, no letters, no figure, no floor.
decals.base-drain: Asset for Turnip Works. A flat RING made of exactly SIX separate thick curved segments with clear even gaps between them, seen exactly from straight above (top-down, orthographic), like a segmented health meter around a coin: PURE WHITE segments on a PURE BLACK background (#000000), nothing else. One gap is exactly at 12 o'clock and the others every 60 degrees (at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 o'clock). Each segment is a chunky rounded band, all six identical. The centre is empty black (about 70% of the diameter). Perfectly round, centred, filling about 92% of the frame. No glow, no text, no shading, no texture.
decals.plate-label: Asset for Turnip Works, a cosy rustic fantasy tabletop game with hand-painted miniatures. One small BLANK wooden PLAQUE / sign plate for a short word, seen straight on: a wide rounded-rectangle (about 4 times as wide as tall) of dark warm wood with a thin painted cream border and slightly rounded corners, flat and simple, a little painted wood grain, completely EMPTY in the middle (no text, no letters, no symbols: words are added later). Fills the frame width with a small margin. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no shadow, no nails, no chains.
